Character.CharacterText16_Honwaka_Plural:
The type that takes care of others.
 He is the type of person who cares about others.
 Do not be deceived, as they do not suspect others.
Character.CharacterText16_Sabasaba:
Intelligent and not afraid to show it.
Knowledgeable in a wide range of
subjects. Answers with confidence.
Character.CharacterText16_Gangan:
Bold and captivating. Their wit and
charm light up a room. It's never a
dull moment when they're around!
Character.CharacterText16_Baribari_Plural:
A strict leader type.
 He is a strict leader! He puts all his energy into what he thinks is the right thing to do.
 He sometimes struggles with the gap between ideals and reality...
Character.CharacterText16_Kirakira:
Radiant and always on form. Their
effortless style is admired by all.
Easily adapts to new situations.
Character.CharacterText16_Mattari_Plural:
Laid-back and carefree type.
 He lives at his own pace and is not in a hurry.
 However, he also worries a lot.
Character.CharacterText16_Waiwai_Plural:
The type that wants to enjoy everything.
 He gets along easily with strangers.
 Someone who can turn even the hardest things into something to look forward to.
Character.CharacterText16_Fuwafuwa_Plural:
The ultimate healing type.
 When she's happy, it immediately shows on her face.
 When things are unpleasant, they also show on their faces immediately.
Character.CharacterText16_Mojimoji:
Unique, carefree, creative, laid-back.
They're self-reliant, doing things their
own way and thinking outside the box.
Character.CharacterText16_Kirakira_Plural:
Everyone's idol type.
 Always full of energy and full of motivation,
 She is everyone's idol. But behind the scenes, she has a hard time.
Character.CharacterText16_Baribari:
Risk taking and ambitious. Full of
energy and acts on many whims.
Once they start, they don't stop!
Character.CharacterText16_Nikoniko_Plural:
The type that always has a smile on her face.
 Not only smiling, but also acting in a way that everyone can have fun.
 but also acts in a way that everyone can have fun.
Character.CharacterText16_Tekipaki:
Diligent, productive, and highly
efficient. Equally as skilled at
planning and executing plans.
Character.CharacterText16_Gangan_Plural:
A mass of energy type.
 He will do anything on the spur of the moment.
 Once he starts doing something, no one can stop him.
Character.CharacterText16_Sin:
Self-sufficient and highly individual.
Doesn't show much outward emotion,
but has a lot going on deep down.
Character.CharacterText16_Honwaka:
Trustworthy and considerate. Puts
their friends first and works hard to
make sure everyone gets along.
Character.Feature4_Dry:
A by-the-book straight-talker.
Puts a premium on results.
Character.CharacterText16_Sabasaba_Plural:
I am the type of person who likes to be alone.
 She is not a lively person, but she has a lot of inner strength,
 but he has a lot of inner strength.
Character.FirstImpression4_Dry_Plural: person who has great confidence (faith) in himself
Character.CharacterText16_Kicchiri_Plural:
He is the type of person who takes everything seriously.
 He is quiet, but says what he wants to say.
 He rarely breaks the rules.
Character.Feature4_Nagomi_Plural:
Slow-paced, naïve & delicate
 Honest, attentive, friendly to all
Character.CharacterText16_Kicchiri:
Imaginative and inspired. Happiest
when creating something. Finds
beauty in everyone and everything.
Character.CharacterText16_Tekipaki_Plural:
A type of person who works hard with a strong spirit.
 The higher the goal, the more passionate he is.
 He can also be a bit on the droll side...
Character.CharacterText16_Bassari:
A determined self-starter. Cuts their
own path, letting nothing stand in
their way. Quick to execute plans.
Character.CharacterText16_Meramera:
Assertive and highly regarded.
Trusts their own instincts, and easily
commands the respect of others.
Character.CharacterText16_Mattari:
Idealistic and romantic. Often has
their head in the clouds, but finds
a lot of great ideas up there.
Character.Feature4_Nori:
Optimistic and passionate.
Follows their instincts.
Character.Feature4_Nagomi:
Thoughtful, honest, innocent.
Does things at their own pace.
Character.CharacterText16_Bassari_Plural:
The type that goes its own way.
 He doesn't care what Strangers says,
 He is a smart guy who acts quickly in everything.
Character.Feature4_Nori_Plural:
Intuition and momentum oriented, rough around the edges
 Optimistic, easily heated and cooled
Character.CharacterText16_Jikkuri_Plural:
The type that does not show their feelings on their face.
 He is good at thinking things over carefully.
 He has a problem with formalities.
Character.CharacterText16_Nikoniko:
Positive, enthusiastic, and always
beaming. Smiles for their own sake
and to help others smile too.
Character.CharacterText16_Sin_Plural:
He is as reserved as possible.
 What he thinks is never on his face and
 And she rarely says what she is thinking out loud. But he has a strong core.
Character.CharacterText16_Meramera_Plural:
A hot-blooded type that runs with a rush.
 When something interesting happens, he enjoys
 and enjoys it. A little pushy.
Character.CharacterText16_Fuwafuwa:
Empathetic and sentimental.
Sensitive, emotional, and in
tune with the feelings of others.
Character.CharacterText16_Mojimoji_Plural:
Strong and patient type.
 He values Strangers more than himself and avoids conflict.
 But if he puts up with too much, he can get into trouble...
Character.CharacterText16_Jikkuri:
Thoughtful and introspective. Great
at thinking things through and
analyzing issues from every angle.
Character.CharacterText16_Waiwai:
Outgoing and pleasant to be around.
Makes friends easily, and can turn
any bad situation into a good one.

Food_Caption.Caption_Banana:
Nature's dessert. Watch out where you
put that peel—it's dangerous!
Food_Caption.Caption_Biscuit:
Lightly buttered with a hint of salt.
It's like a blank canvas for snacking.
Food_Caption.Caption_Edamame:
Boiled and salted to perfection.
Impossible to stop eating once you start.
Food_Caption.Caption_Rollmop:
Rolled fillets of pickled herring with veggies.
If you like tangy stuff, this is your snack.
Food_Caption.Caption_Churros:
Sticks of fried dough covered in sugar
and cinnamon. What's not to like?
Food_Caption.Caption_Spinach:
A pile of leafy greens cooked
down to nearly nothing.
Food_Caption.Caption_Mango:
It looks so lonely without any pineapple
by its side. Put it out of its misery.
Food_Caption.Caption_OmijyaCha:
"Omija" refers to the five potential
flavors in this magnolia-berry tea.
Food_Caption.Caption_Peanut:
Peanuts are nuts, right? Nope. They're
actually legumes. Nutty but true!
Food_Caption.Caption_ChickenPotPie:
Fill a flaky pie crust with chicken and
gravy, and you get this. Evil or genius?
Food_Caption.Caption_EiyouDrink:
For when you need a little extra
oomph to get through your day.
Food_Caption.Caption_KabiPan:
Ew. Ew, gross. That bread may be
cheap, but that doesn't make it edible.
Food_Caption.Caption_CupNudle:
You're three minutes away from total
noodle-ocity. Can you wait that long?
Food_Caption.Caption_Ravioli:
Pillowy pasta pockets of ricotta
and spinach. When in Rome!
Food_Caption.Caption_Chapuche:
Glass noodles and thinly sliced
veggies stir-fried in sesame oil.
Food_Caption.Caption_Falafel:
Bite-size balls of fried chickpeas.
Pop 'em as is or enjoy in a gyro.
Food_Caption.Caption_GyuDon:
A jumbo serving with a jumbo amount of
broth! Best enjoyed while piping hot.
Food_Caption.Caption_Pancake:
Fluffy yum cakes drenched in warm
maple syrup. You're welcome.
Food_Caption.Caption_Soumen:
Hits the spot on hot summer days.
Slurp up and cool down!
Food_Caption.Caption_Okayu:
A deceivingly simple dish that'll remind
you of your best days as a toddler.
Food_Caption.Caption_Licorice:
A handful of black-licorice twists that get
their distinct flavor from the licorice plant.
Food_Caption.Caption_ChocolateEasterEgg:
Now if only we could find the
chocolate bunny...
Food_Caption.Caption_Haggis:
Some might call this hearty Scottish
dish, uh...an acquired taste.
Food_Caption.Caption_Croissant:
The breakfast of French champions.
Made of soft, bready loveliness.
Food_Caption.Caption_ChocoParfait:
Tons of ice cream isn't sweet enough,
thus the whipped cream and fudge.
Food_Caption.Caption_MakadamiaNuts:
The most luxurious nut out there. Way
cheaper than a Hawaiian vacation.
Food_Caption.Caption_Herring:
Straight from the ocean to you. It's not
red, which is probably a good thing.
Food_Caption.Caption_FrozenYogurt:
The texture of ice cream with
the tartness of yogurt!
Food_Caption.Caption_Smores:
This graham-cracker concoction
will have you begging for s'more.
Food_Caption.Caption_CustardPastry:
Known for having a sweet eggy flavor
and being impossible to resist.
Food_Caption.Caption_KrTougarashi:
Not quite ripe. Try cooking it instead of
eating it raw if you're not a lover of spice.
Food_Caption.Caption_BanhMi:
A popular Vietnamese sandwich overflowing
with meat and pickled veggies.
Food_Caption.Caption_BakedPotato:
A soft, mushy baked potato loaded with
cheese, butter, and more cheese.
Food_Caption.Caption_BeefBourguignon:
Beef simmered low and slow in a rich
broth. Somehow both fancy and homey.
Food_Caption.Caption_Namuru:
Wild veggies and greens dressed to the
nines. Tough to decide which to eat first!
Food_Caption.Caption_MapleTaffy:
More maple than maple syrup. Poured onto
fresh snow, then lifted with an ice-pop stick.
Food_Caption.Caption_FriedPlantains:
A subtle caramelized sweetness
that rivals any dessert.
Food_Caption.Caption_RoastedGoose:
Slow roasted to draw out all those rich
flavors. Crispy yet tender. Perfection!
Food_Caption.Caption_EggsAndTomatoes:
Fluffy eggs tossed with well-sautéed
tomatoes and sprinkled with green onion.
Food_Caption.Caption_Salad:
The secret to a tasty salad is texture,
crunch, and a zippy dressing!
Food_Caption.Caption_Subuta:
Much like life, it's both sweet and sour.
Unlike life, it comes with extra sauce.
Food_Caption.Caption_Omurice:
Ketchup-seasoned rice tucked into a fluffy
omelet and doused in even more ketchup.
Food_Caption.Caption_SmokedSalmon:
Razor-thin slices of smoked salmon and
a handful of capers. Pass the crackers.
Food_Caption.Caption_BakedBeans:
The beans were actually stewed in tomato
sauce, not baked. Sorry for the confusion.
Food_Caption.Caption_Gazpacho:
A refreshing summertime soup
served cold. Yeah, you heard me.
Food_Caption.Caption_TatiuoYaki:
"Cutlass" is right. Watch out for sharp
bones when you enjoy this one.
Food_Caption.Caption_Dango:
Pairs perfectly with a picnic
under cherry-blossom trees.
Food_Caption.Caption_Sandwich:
The mark of a successful sandwich is
not being able to hold it with one hand.
Food_Caption.Caption_GingerCookies:
Sweet cookie spiced with
ginger and cinnamon.
Food_Caption.Caption_RingoAme:
If you can eat this without becoming a
sticky mess, you're officially a legend.
Food_Caption.Caption_CherryPie:
It's hardly cherry pie without the lattice
top. Good thing it's still delectable.
Food_Caption.Caption_StringCheese:
Stringy cheese that's fun to peel and
small enough to slip in your lunch box.
Food_Caption.Caption_Moule:
Freshly harvested and steamed
to open-shelled perfection.
Food_Caption.Caption_ZukkiniNoTijimi:
Juicy zucchini coated in batter and baked.
Next-level delicious with soy sauce.
Food_Caption.Caption_Mithai:
{ArticleA}South Asia Tour souvenir. A variety of
milk-based Indian sweets. Enjoy with chai.
Food_Caption.Caption_Candy:
This lollipop is as big as your face.
That's an awful lotta lolly.
Food_Caption.Caption_Muffin:
Positively teeming with blueberries and
raspberries. Enjoy that fruity flavor.
Food_Caption.Caption_Gingerbread:
It may not be shaped like a delightful
little person, but it's still rather tasty.
Food_Caption.Caption_Tyawanmushi:
A casserole-like egg custard in
an earthenware pot.
Food_Caption.Caption_Suyuku:
A simple and satisfying dish made of
boiled pork. Season as desired.
Food_Caption.Caption_Mushroom:
The most flavorful fungus of all, which
is not a difficult competition to win.
Food_Caption.Caption_Reba:
Just smell that delicious sauce!
No, I swear—it's actually really good!
Food_Caption.Caption_DeviledEggs:
Not as scary as they sound. Egg whites
filled with a mix of yolk, mustard, and mayo.
Food_Caption.Caption_Songpyeon:
Rice cake steamed with pine needles that
comes in several yummy flavors.
Food_Caption.Caption_DimSum:
Bite-size morsels from China that come
in many different shapes and flavors.
Food_Caption.Caption_Harumaki:
Crispy pockets of pure enjoyment.
It's hard to save room for the meal.
Food_Caption.Caption_Oyster:
Drizzle with lemon or hot sauce
and enjoy in one gulp!
Food_Caption.Caption_Salami:
A small plate of spicy, sliced sausage.
Keep for yourself or share with friends.
Food_Caption.Caption_Borscht:
A vibrant red soup with lots of veggies.
Can be served hot or cold.
Food_Caption.Caption_SundobuTige:
Soft and fluffy tofu is the star of the
show in this spicy seafood stew.
Food_Caption.Caption_Enchilada:
The spicy sauce and creamy cheese combo
might be the closest we get to perfection.
Food_Caption.Caption_Katudon:
The fluffy egg on top really takes this cutlet
to the next level. Best with piping hot rice!
Food_Caption.Caption_Celery:
If you dislike it on its own, add peanut
butter and raisins for a fun variation.
Food_Caption.Caption_Cherimoya:
Fruit with creamy flesh. At utmost
ripeness when starting to brown.
Food_Caption.Caption_Carrot:
Grated to the perfect size for shoving
entire handfuls in your mouth.
Food_Caption.Caption_YakiGuri:
Sweet and freshly roasted! We mean fresh.
Don't burn your tongue on these.
Food_Caption.Caption_Chawanmushi:
A savory egg custard for only
the most refined palates.
Food_Caption.Caption_Karubonara:
A creamy pasta dish made with egg and
cheese that tastes restaurant-level fancy.
Food_Caption.Caption_Kiwi:
How can the perfect balance of sweet and
tart be contained in such a tiny fruit?
Food_Caption.Caption_SippaiRyouri:
Somebody's a bad cook. Or has a sick
sense of humor. Or doesn't like you.
Food_Caption.Caption_SunflowerSeeds:
Channel your inner bird by snacking
down on these crackly seeds.
Food_Caption.Caption_MashedPotato:
Whoever invented mashing potatoes
deserves an award. Nobel Potato?
Food_Caption.Caption_MintCandy:
A refreshing minty punch for when
your mouth needs a pick-me-up.
Food_Caption.Caption_ChirashiSushi:
It doesn't get much more festive than this!
A big bowl of sushi rice with tasty goodies.
Food_Caption.Caption_CornDog:
A fried hot dog on a stick, for busy
people with no time to fuss with buns.
Food_Caption.Caption_Toppogi:
Long, thin rice cakes stir-fried in a
sweet-and-spicy sauce.
Food_Caption.Caption_RoastChicken:
A plump, roasted chicken resting on
a bed of Yukon Gold potatoes.
Food_Caption.Caption_HashBrowns:
Shredded potatoes fried to form these
golden patties of breakfast potential.
Food_Caption.Caption_ElephantEar:
A sweet puff pastry dusted with sugar
and shaped like an elephant ear.
Food_Caption.Caption_Strawberry:
It's the red in red-flavored stuff. Sweet,
tart, and brilliant with whipped cream.
Food_Caption.Caption_Omelet:
Only the finest eggs were used for this
creation. It longs to be paired with ketchup.
Food_Caption.Caption_CornSoup:
Sure to warm you from your heart to
your toes. Your head's on its own.
Food_Caption.Caption_Stuffing:
Bread crumbs with onions and celery.
Eat as is or stuff inside something else.
Food_Caption.Caption_Cannoli:
Fried pastry dough stuffed with sweet
cream. So good it's bursting at the seams.
Food_Caption.Caption_Walnut:
A nearly impossible nut to crack
unless you have, well, a nutcracker.
Food_Caption.Caption_Yakisoba:
Fried noodles covered in tangy sauce
and finished with bean sprouts.
Food_Caption.Caption_Polenta:
Ah, the endless utility of corn... Enjoy this
dish either hot or cold!
Food_Caption.Caption_MagretDeCanard:
To be super fancy, enjoy with a fruit sauce.
And stick your pinkie out while you eat.
Food_Caption.Caption_Kyabia:
Disliking caviar means you're unrefined.
Or don't like fish eggs. One of the two.
Food_Caption.Caption_ZyagaBata:
This dish has almost as much butter
as it does potato. Mmm, melty.
Food_Caption.Caption_BoiledEgg:
Don't worry—the yolk is perfectly soft.
Try a little salt and pepper on top!
Food_Caption.Caption_Truffle:
It looks like a fungus, but it's
actually high-class foodstuff.
Food_Caption.Caption_Uni:
Yoinked this one right out of the sea!
Can't recommend eating the spiky bits.
Food_Caption.Caption_Pandoro:
Dig into the golden peaks of this
powdered-sugar-topped confection.
Food_Caption.Caption_BreadChocolateCream:
Unclear if this is actually breakfast or just
a snack, but can confirm it is delicious.
Food_Caption.Caption_SaltineCrackers:
These crackers look naked without
soup to dip them in. Sad, really.
Food_Caption.Caption_Geppei:
A traditional Chinese food eaten
during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
Food_Caption.Caption_KhaoManGai:
A classic Thai dish served with
soup and a rich, spicy sauce.
Food_Caption.Caption_Melon:
This fragrant melon is a sweet
snack that smacks of summer.
Food_Caption.Caption_MonzyaYaki:
Somehow crispy and gooey at the same
time. Eat it with a special spatula.
Food_Caption.Caption_GreekStyleSalad:
Fresh Mediterranean veg tossed with feta
cheese and generous amounts of olive oil.
Food_Caption.Caption_CandyCorn:
The bane of many a trick-or-treater's
existence. There's always too much.
Food_Caption.Caption_Nudle:
Japanese noodles with pork, egg, and
seaweed. Have fun slurping that soup.
Food_Caption.Caption_Garlic:
It's known to keep vampires away.
Maybe they're afraid of bad breath?
Food_Caption.Caption_Makuwauri:
An adorable li'l member of the
melon family. Mildly sweet.
Food_Caption.Caption_Kanjyankejyan:
Fermented crabs flavored with a chili
powder or ganjang base. Great with rice!
Food_Caption.Caption_CapreseSalad:
A simple but refreshing summer dish best
enjoyed on an oceanfront veranda.
Food_Caption.Caption_Zampone:
A massive sausage served
on a bed of lentils.
Food_Caption.Caption_CheeseBoard:
{ArticleA}Western Europe Tour souvenir. A must-have
for parties. Including parties of one.
Food_Caption.Caption_EbiChili:
Prawns are good on their own, but
they're better with garlic and chilies.
Food_Caption.Caption_Cutlet:
A thin cut of pork, boiled and savory.
Silverware is optional but a good idea.
Food_Caption.Caption_Ebifurai:
The quintessential shrimp dish.
Crispy outside, tender inside.
Food_Caption.Caption_Osechi:
A traditional Japanese New Year's
dish meant to bestow good luck.
Food_Caption.Caption_Tenpura:
Just when you thought shrimp and
veggies couldn't get any tastier!
Food_Caption.Caption_Millefeuille:
Creamy cream and layers of flaky crust.

Mmm, just hear that steak sizzle! Huh?
What do you mean it's burning?

If you can eat these without cringing,

Veal wrapped in prosciutto and sage,

Therapy in a bowl. We recommend waiting to
eat the tofu until it soaks up lots of broth.

See if you can handle the spice.

It smells kind of fruit-like, but there's

A hearty English breakfast to
propel you through the day.

You better chow down on this summer

Masa dough wrapped in a corn husk and

Fried chicken dripping with sweet 'n' spicy

You could chew on it forever and not get

The only ingredient is organic, local

A classic German sweet bread dotted with

Immerse yourself in the eggy goodness

Ginseng chicken soup. Aromatic and

The bigger the bean pile, the better!
Eat with your hands if you dare.

A scorching-hot pot of two broths and

Frothy milk floating atop bitter coffee.

Whoever said not to play with your food

A savory pancake filled with

Pickles are like mutated cucumbers. If

It gets its power from electrolytes. It's

They sure didn't scrimp on the

You won't be able to stop eating this

Nothing says Sunday brunch like a

Whatever floats your ice cream.

An apple in its nonjuice form. Good for
when you want some satisfying crunch.

That is A LOT of ice cream. Whoa.

The texture of oats and creamy richness

Fluffy bread that's nearly foundational

Sweet and fuzzy with an adorable pink

If you look really hard, you can see

Boiled until tender. Slurp them

The apex of strawberry shaved ice.

Typically served to families, but we

A juicy chicken leg with supersecret

Baked in the oven until it achieves that

Teeny-tiny puffed grains served

A thick, sour, spicy delight

Called a Danish, but it's really Austrian.

A Spanish dessert similar to French

Nestled in this split banana, you'll find

Authentic kimchi straight from Korea.

This cheese has been aged with blue

Dried and salted cod. Today's selection has
been baked into a croquette. Yum!

Crabs so freshly caught they might

A food you eat right before spring begins
for some good luck.

A rich Italian sweet bread

Juicy grilled pork belly

Kimchi made of diced daikon radish.

What more could you ask for than a hot
cinnamon roll with ooey, gooey icing?

A kimchi-and-flour mix that's fried to

Brewed with fresh, delicate leaves.

Thick slabs of savory roast beef just

Charcoal-grilled chicken on bamboo

Baked until golden. Or perhaps that's

Impress your dinner guests by treating

Tastes great with soy sauce.

A delightful fall fruit bursting
with subtle sweetness.

A very long sandwich stuffed with meat

Battered fish-and-potato patties,

For anyone out there who's
ever wanted to drink a pizza.

A soft, chocolaty brownie with walnuts

Honey, sugar, meringue, and toasted

Sliced cucumber, ham, and omelet served

Nothing's more satisfying than the crunch

They say it's your birthday. Happy

Bubbling beans and tomatoes accented

A big ol' bowl of comfort. Kick it up

Milk so bad it's basically cheese now.

Good for comedy routines. You can also
eat it, probably.

Step one: eat space food. Step two: go to
space. At least step one is easy.

The best of both cake
and carrot worlds.
Food_Caption.Caption_CornishPasty:
Science cannot yet explain how so much
savory goodness fits in one pie crust.

Seasoned beef sashimi

A hearty, spicy dish of thinly
sliced meat and veggies.

Pizza is the people's food. Crust with
stuff on it is the recipe for bliss.

silly with whipped cream and cherries.

a low flame, sometimes for a whole day!

Say "yellow" to the ocean's finest,

Red beans and rice typically eaten

Your cat would go bonkers if it knew

Glutinous rice wrapped in bamboo leaves.

The best part of sashimi: no cooking

bursting with red-bean-paste goodness.

This potent condiment will clear the ol'

charcoal-fire-whisperer skills.

Grilled meat galore with a side of
peppers and corn on the cob.

Cheese melted juuust before it's scraped

It looks weird and smells weirder, but

Torched to caramelized perfection!

{ArticleA}Kyoto Tour souvenir. High-grade, freshly
ground tea leaves from Kyoto.

Pillowy-soft seared eel delicately placed

This stew has been stewing for hours.

A fine choice for a quick breakfast.

A spicy seasoning made of rice malt

Fresh, fragrant grapes, bright as jewels.

Homemade lasagna is the best kind

Thinly sliced so you can keep going
back for more. Ham it up!

Delectable pie made from fresh pumpkins,

Creamy chicken curry cooked with
a delectable blend of spices.

Crispy shells stuffed with spicy fillings

Chilled and refreshing. Kick it up a notch
with some green onions and ginger.

Basically a hamburger without the bun.

Wiggly, wobbly flan drenched in smoky
caramel sauce. Both fun and tasty.

Best piping hot. Add fruit and sugar

An ancient root often used in herbal
remedies. Resentfully bitter.

These dazzling, golden-brown beauties

Even a basic dish hits different when a pro

Pasta, Parmesan, and pine nuts got
married. This is their beautiful baby.

A traditional English pudding.
Best served on fire!

A robust Korean tea made from jujube

Slowly simmered until tender. The recipe

Mix it all together for the classic version.
Leave everything separate if you feel wild.

Bright red and bursting with flavor!
The sourer the kimchi, the better.

Deep-fried pastry dough covered in all
the powdered sugar a pantry could offer.
Food_Caption.Caption_Dalgona:
Spongy, toffee-like sugar candy

The tangy flavor and creamy texture

Freshly boiled tentacles. Eat alone, or

Stir-fried kimchi served with soft tofu.

A Thai recipe featuring minced chicken,

High-quality soba noodles

Normal toast is boring. Try frying it and

It's not made of dogs, but it IS hot.
Hope you like mustard. If not...oops.

A side dish of raw cabbage, carrots,

An Italian dove-shaped sweet bread

Food_Caption.Caption_ChaHan:
What's better than a giant plate of
fried rice? Nothing, that's what.

It's not cocoa, and it's not a nut. This

Fresh, mild cheese with good stretch

You've never smelled anything so

A touch of powdered sugar kicks this
devilish chocolate treat up a notch.

Fried until golden, and then fried a

Slow-cooked in a traditional Japanese

A fresh, charcoal-grilled turban shell.
Best enjoyed at a beachside BBQ.

Food_Caption.Caption_Meatsource:
Pasta with ground beef and tomato

A most versatile green! Use the outer leaves

Food_Caption.Caption_LambLeg:
Tender, medium-rare meat.
Savory and a bit gamy.
Food_Caption.Caption_Takoyaki:
The ultimate seafood street food!

These hot and crispy fries will make

You can see through it, it's cut so thin!

Food_Caption.Caption_Kasuziru:
Earthy root veggies and warm broth

Nothing's more classic than peanut
butter meeting jelly on sliced bread.

A South American infusion of yerba

Food_Caption.Caption_Grapefruits:
It's not a grape, but it IS a fruit. Some

It's not burned—it's blackened with ink.
Hope you brought your toothbrush.
Food_Caption.Caption_BeefStew:
Slow cooked for three whole days.
So savory it's for sure worth the wait.
Food_Caption.Caption_CurryRice:
Tons of veggies? Check. Just the
right amount of spice? Check.
Food_Caption.Caption_Nikuman:
It looks like a pastry, but it's actually
filled with juicy, juicy pork.
Food_Caption.Caption_Olive:
Crush them for their oil, or chop them

Food_Caption.Caption_Cherry:
Sure, they're fresh and tasty—but what
a waste to eat something so cute.
Food_Caption.Caption_Chocolate:
Who unwrapped this chocolate bar?!
Oh well—it's still chocolate.
Food_Caption.Caption_FancyCupcake:
How could you say this cupcake isn't
fancy? Look at all those sprinkles!

Soup that somehow channels the warm
energy of a parental hug into liquid form.
Food_Caption.Caption_Gnocchi:
Potato and flour formed up into a pasta

A milky, sweetened porridge. Tasty and

Don't ruin this bold flavor with cream.

Food_Caption.Caption_TaiIkedukuri:
Usually only available at traditional
Japanese restaurants. You're welcome.
Food_Caption.Caption_MisoSoup:
Feel your contentment rise like the steam

Food_Caption.Caption_Waffle:
Waffles trump pancakes because they

Relax and collect your thoughts while

Food_Caption.Caption_FriedSeafoodMix:
An assortment of seafood. Liberally apply

Food_Caption.Caption_Tapa: Enjoyed as an appetizer in Spain.
Food_Caption.Caption_OnionRings:
Is there a better way to enjoy an onion

Anyone can grill a sammy, but it takes

Food_Caption.Caption_MelanzaneAllaParmigiana:
A simple but mighty trio of eggplant,

Food_Caption.Caption_Gyoza:
So crunchy. So crispy. So full of juicy,

Food_Caption.Caption_Yakiimo:
Slowly baked on hot stones

Something important is missing here.
Hold up...where's the pasta?!

Grilled prawns presented on a bed of

There's a lotta kimchi in there.

Food_Caption.Caption_Potof:
Beef stew with various root vegetables.
French home cooking at its finest.
Food_Caption.Caption_MarzipanFruit:
Sweet almond paste kneaded into dough,

Sweet vanilla ice cream made with

A small fungus with a big price tag.

Food_Caption.Caption_YakiNasu:
Delicious strips of zucchini grilled

Crispy tortilla chips topped with pico

Food_Caption.Caption_Fudge:
So many flavors, so little time.

Food_Caption.Caption_KrNori:
Crisp sheets of seaweed flavored

Food_Caption.Caption_Natto:
Delicious over hot rice! If you can get

This sweet fruit has a ton of vitamin C.

Pickled to perfection. Serve with
freshly cooked rice.
Food_Caption.Caption_HandmadeChoco:
Some more anatomically correct than

Hopefully you like the taste of tears.

Simmered slowly to coax out all

Pickled and fermented cabbage. A good

Food_Caption.Caption_MaboTofu:

Bodybuilders drink this like water. Get

A southern breakfast staple. It's

Savory paste made from chickpeas, salt,

Rice porridge made with abalone.

Just smell that sweet sweetfish!

Look up "comfort" in a dictionary, and

The perfect bun with the

Food_Caption.Caption_Gumi:
Soft, chewy lumps of

Cheesy macaroni gratin with a savory

Deep-fried pork covered in a yummy sauce.

Bonito flakes and hot rice are a match made
